metadata.name: Manasa B.
metadata.title: Senior Staff Frontend Architect
metadata.bio: 11+ years shipping React, Angular & TypeScript. Specializing in high-throughput enterprise architectures with proven track record modernizing and scaling digital engines across Intuit, Fidelity, AT&T, Vanguard, Korn Ferry, Virgin Mobile, and JP Morgan Chase. Deployed client error suppression systems serving 350K+ daily users with typed, zero-regression CI/CD releases.
metadata.tagline: Architecting frontend systems, from pixels to pipelines

experiences.description: Led architecture and implementation of contact-expert integration platform, designing marketing suppression logic and shipping features serving 350K+ daily users. Pioneered zero-regression TypeScript CI/CD pipeline for frontend releases.
keyAccomplishments: Architected and shipped client error suppression system serving 350K+ daily users with typed, zero-regression CI/CD releases
Designed GraphQL schema and resolver patterns for expert network platform connecting SMBs with on-demand accountants
Modernized legacy Angular codebase to React/TypeScript ecosystem, improving bundle size by 40% and reducing load time by 2.3s
Led mentorship of 4 junior engineers on frontend architecture, design patterns, and performance optimization
Implemented real-time availability updates using WebSockets and Kafka event streaming

experiences.description: Built high-throughput investment tracking dashboard and portfolio management interfaces for institutional and retail clients. Optimized React rendering for real-time market data streaming.
keyAccomplishments: Optimized React rendering pipeline for real-time market data (10K+ updates/sec) achieving 60 FPS with custom render batching
Built WebSocket consumer for live market quotes, reducing latency from 2.5s to <200ms
Mentored 3 junior engineers on Redux architecture, performance profiling, and React best practices
Designed responsive dashboard components serving 500K+ concurrent users
Implemented client-side caching layer reducing API calls by 65%

experiences.description: Engineered customer-facing web applications for telecom billing, account management, and service provisioning. Scaled frontend infrastructure to support 20M+ active users.
keyAccomplishments: Built responsive billing dashboard serving 20M+ AT&T customers with <2s load time
Implemented progressive web app (PWA) for offline-first account management
Led migration from legacy jQuery to modern React/Redux architecture across 8 teams
Optimized bundle size from 2.8MB to 640KB using code splitting and dynamic imports
Designed and documented reusable component library used across 6 product teams

experiences.description: Designed and developed interactive financial planning tools and investment research interfaces. Focused on accessibility and usability for diverse investor demographics.
keyAccomplishments: Built interactive asset allocation tool reducing time-to-decision by 3x for retail investors
Achieved WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across all 40+ product pages improving accessibility for 15K+ users
Designed design system with 80+ reusable components reducing development time by 45%
Implemented real-time portfolio performance charts using D3.js and Canvas API
Mentored interns on responsive design and accessibility best practices

experiences.description: Developed enterprise talent management and executive search platform. Built interactive candidate profile interfaces and search/filtering algorithms.
keyAccomplishments: Built advanced search and filtering UI for 500K+ candidate profiles with faceted navigation
Implemented real-time chat interface for recruiter-candidate communication
Optimized query performance reducing search latency from 3.2s to 400ms
Created data visualization dashboard for hiring analytics and pipeline tracking
Built email template builder allowing recruiters to customize outreach campaigns

experiences.description: Developed mobile-first telecommunications customer portal and billing interfaces. Focused on performance optimization for low-bandwidth users.
keyAccomplishments: Built mobile-first customer portal serving 2M+ monthly users with focus on <3G performance
Implemented touch-optimized interface components for iOS and Android browsers
Optimized page load time from 4.2s to 1.1s through lazy loading and asset optimization
Created automated test suite reducing regression bugs by 80%
Built real-time account top-up system processing 50K+ transactions/day

experiences.description: Built internal trading analytics and risk monitoring dashboards. Worked with financial data visualization and real-time updates.
keyAccomplishments: Built real-time risk dashboard ingesting 1M+ market data points per second
Implemented WebSocket feed for live trading alerts with <50ms latency
Created interactive risk heat maps using custom Canvas rendering
Optimized memory usage of data-heavy pages reducing memory leaks by 70%

projects.name: Live Customer Hub
projects.description: Multi-tenant expert network platform connecting small businesses with on-demand accounting and bookkeeping services.
projects.fullDescription: A high-performance React SPA serving 100K+ monthly active users with real-time expert availability, video chat integration, appointment booking, and payment processing. Features AI-powered matching algorithm, 99.9% uptime SLA, and zero-regression deployment pipeline.
keyFeatures: Real-time expert availability and presence detection
Video chat and screen sharing with Agora SDK

projects.name: Contact Expert Widget
projects.description: Embeddable React widget for QuickBooks users to discover, book, and connect with on-demand accounting experts.
projects.fullDescription: A self-contained web component built with React and TypeScript that integrates seamlessly into QuickBooks interfaces. Handles expert discovery, appointment booking, payment, and video conferencing. Supports multiple themes and is fully accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA).

projects.name: Expert Services Bootstrap
projects.description: Foundational service architecture, GraphQL schema, and deployment pipeline for expert network features across Intuit products.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive engineering foundation including GraphQL API design, backend service templates, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring infrastructure, and documentation. Enables rapid development of expert-related features across multiple Intuit product teams.

projects.name: Portfolio & Blog Platform
projects.description: Next.js-based personal portfolio with in-repo database, API routes, and MDX support for technical writing.
projects.fullDescription: A modern portfolio website built with Next.js, featuring in-repo JSON data storage, API routes for data fetching, Tailwind CSS styling, and SEO optimization. Includes blog functionality with MDX for interactive technical articles.
keyFeatures: In-repo JSON database with API routes
Dark mode with custom Tailwind theme
Rotating 'OPEN TO WORK' SVG badge animation
SEO optimized with metadata and Open Graph
